blurb: Daytona Beach Golf Club offers two 18-hole golf courses: the South Course, a Donald Ross design with forgiving tee shots and demanding approaches, and the North Course, rebuilt in 1997 with more water hazards and undulating greens for a greater challenge. The club provides rental clubs and a driving range. The Sandtrap Bar & Grill serves breakfast and lunch on site.
extraNote: Rental clubs cannot be reserved; first come first serve · Rental clubs must be returned before closing time; no rentals after 12:00PM · Rainchecks issued after accumulation of rain causing unplayable conditions, valid 30 days
